Q: Restrict an SQL Server connection to a specific IP address A: 
USE master
GO
IF EXISTS(SELECT NAME FROM sys.tables AS t WHERE t.name= 'seguridad_errores')
BEGIN
    EXECUTE('DROP TABLE dbo.seguridad_errores;');
END

IF EXISTS(SELECT NAME FROM sys.tables AS t WHERE t.name= 'seguridad_errores_login')
BEGIN
    EXECUTE('DROP TABLE dbo.seguridad_errores_login;');
END

CREATE TABLE dbo.seguridad_errores
(
    LogDate         DATETIME
   ,ProcessInfo     SYSNAME
   ,[Text]          NVARCHAR(MAX)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.seguridad_errores_login
(
    TEXT     NVARCHAR(MAX)
   ,ip       NVARCHAR(40)
)

INSERT dbo.seguridad_errores
EXEC xp_readerrorlog;


INSERT dbo.seguridad_errores_login
SELECT t.[Text]
      ,''
FROM   dbo.seguridad_errores AS t
WHERE  t.[Text] LIKE '%Login failed for user%CLIENT:%'

UPDATE t
SET    t.ip = LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(
           SUBSTRING(t.[TEXT] ,CHARINDEX('[CLIENT: ' ,t.[TEXT])+9 ,20)
          ,']'
          ,''
       )))
FROM   dbo.seguridad_errores_login AS t

DELETE t
FROM   dbo.seguridad_errores_login AS t
WHERE  t.ip IN 
(
'127.0.0.1' --localhost
,'<local machine>');

SELECT ip FROM dbo.seguridad_errores_login AS el GROUP BY el.ip ORDER BY el.ip

DECLARE @tsql NVARCHAR(MAX) = 'sudo sh -c '''
SELECT  @tsql += CONCAT('ufw deny from ', te.ip, ';') FROM dbo.seguridad_errores_login AS te GROUP BY te.ip
SELECT @tsql = SUBSTRING(@tsql, 1, LEN(@tsql)-1) + ''''

SELECT @tsql  AS [Ubuntu Firewall]

DECLARE @tsql1 NVARCHAR(MAX) = 'sudo sh -c '''
SELECT  @tsql1 += CONCAT('fail2ban-client set mssql-auth banip ', te.ip, ';') FROM dbo.seguridad_errores_login AS te GROUP BY te.ip
SELECT @tsql1 += ''''
SELECT @tsql1 AS [Ubuntu Fail2Ban MSSQL-AUTH]

DECLARE @tsql2 NVARCHAR(MAX) = 'sudo sh -c '''
SELECT  @tsql2 += CONCAT('fail2ban-client set sshd banip ', te.ip, ';') FROM dbo.seguridad_errores_login AS te GROUP BY te.ip
SELECT @tsql2 += ''''
SELECT @tsql2 AS [Ubuntu Fail2Ban SSHD]

DECLARE @tsql3 NVARCHAR(MAX) = 'netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name=''BLACKLIST_IP'' dir=in action=block remoteip='
SELECT  @tsql3 += CONCAT(te.ip, ',') FROM dbo.seguridad_errores_login AS te GROUP BY te.ip
SELECT @tsql = SUBSTRING(@tsql, 1, LEN(@tsql)-1)
SELECT @tsql3 AS [Windows Firewall]

Q: Attempting to add a module-info.java to spark.core.2.13 of Apache Spark: how to make scala accepting module delaration and gather its classes? A:

My first advice is not about this topic per se but rather the fact that you want to work on a major proposal for a major community project: engage with the Spark contributors first before "wasting" your time. They may not want to go this road, or maybe they've already tried and found out it's not possible, or... whatever reason.

The referenced issue (https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/SPARK-34243) hasn't got any traction in 5 years.
